study type: Secondary data analysis of a cross-sectional survey
cohort: 11,375 women in Ethiopia who participated in the 2016 Ethiopian Demographic and Health Survey
finding: Stillbirth in Ethiopia showed significant spatial variation, with higher rates associated with rural residence, lower maternal education, lack of antenatal care, caesarean delivery, short birth intervals, and shorter maternal height.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was significantly associated with an increased risk of stillbirth.
